title.en: Give Uniswap's Permit2 an allowance for one token (unlimited)
title.zh-TW: 授權 Uniswap 的 Permit2 使用一個代幣（無上限）

summary.en: The Safe calls `approve` on the token you pick, giving Permit2 an unlimited allowance. The Uniswap app asks for this allowance before it first sells a token. Permit2 itself cannot use it; the Safe must later give a contract (such as the Universal Router) a separate allowance in Permit2.
summary.zh-TW: Safe 對你選的代幣呼叫 `approve`，把無上限的額度給 Permit2。這是 Uniswap app 第一次賣某個代幣前要的授權；Permit2 本身不能動用它，要 Safe 之後在 Permit2 另外授權某個合約（例如 Universal Router）才行。

text.en: The unlimited allowance to Permit2 stays. Only a contract the Safe has separately given an allowance in Permit2 can use it.
text.zh-TW: 無上限授權給 Permit2 會留著；只有 Safe 另外在 Permit2 授權過的合約能用。

pastTxsConclusion.en: No Safe approval to Permit2 was found. EOA misfits approve other spenders, or give Permit2 an exact amount or 0.
pastTxsConclusion.zh-TW: 沒找到 Safe 給 Permit2 的授權。EOA 不合的是授權給別的 spender，或給 Permit2 固定數量或 0。

text.en: Once Permit2 has the allowance, any Permit2 message the Safe has signed can move this token, and Safe messages (EIP-1271) do not go through kiss-sign.
text.zh-TW: 授權給 Permit2 之後，任何 Safe 簽過的 Permit2 訊息都能動用這個代幣，而 Safe 訊息（EIP-1271）不經過 kiss-sign。

recommendation.en: Before signing any Permit2 message, check the spender. When you stop using Uniswap, set the allowance back to 0.
recommendation.zh-TW: 簽任何 Permit2 訊息前確認 spender；不再用 Uniswap 時把授權改回 0。
